companyAnnouncements: Read our [documentation for agentic tools](https://aka.ms/azsdk/agent) to guide you through the SDK development and release process.
Use `/analyze-code` when you're done making code changes to check code like pull request checks and avoid surprises later. See the `.github/skills` directory for more skills.
Use `/create-recorded-test` to create new recorded tests. See the `.github/skills` directory for more skills.
Use `/create-crate` to create a new crate and, optionally, a new service directory. See the `.github/skills` directory for more skills.
Use `/export-api` to export your public API before submitted a pull request or just to see what the final public API looks like. See the `.github/skills` directory for more skills.

Use the `sdk-reviewer` custom agent to review your crate against the [general](https://azure.github.io/azure-sdk/general_introduction.html) and [Rust Guidelines](https://azure.github.io/azure-sdk/rust_introduction.html).
